blockingFindings.title: R4 pending evidence acceptance is not exercised
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 explicitly requires that no consumer accept a pending or partially applied transaction as current evidence; that acceptance behavior has no corresponding executable coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 test verifies that an injected failure throws, leaves an owned transaction pending, and does not return a recovered result, but it never invokes a stale-evidence consumer while that pending or partially applied transaction exists. An implementation could still accept the pending transaction as current evidence and this test would pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that, after an injected durable failure leaves a pending/partial transaction, a consumer entrypoint refuses to treat it as current recovered evidence until commit completes.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 explicitly requires that no consumer accept a pending or partially applied transaction as current evidence; that acceptance behavior has no corresponding executable coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R9 shared-suite coverage artifact omits required affected test files
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement coverage artifact contradicts the stated R9 coverage obligation and does not account for the actual shared test files the spec-local test depends on.
blockingFindings.issue: R9 requires affected shared unit and CLI lifecycle tests to cover the regression matrix, but the coverage artifact lists only tests/stale-evidence-repair-transaction.test.js. The spec-local test spawns shared suites, yet the artifact does not identify those shared files as requirement coverage targets.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Update the coverage artifact, and where applicable the spec/test headers, so R9 maps to the affected shared unit and CLI lifecycle test files that provide the required coverage.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement coverage artifact contradicts the stated R9 coverage obligation and does not account for the actual shared test files the spec-local test depends on.
